cases.sql: CREATE SCHEMA cq_scope; CREATE TYPE cq_scope.record AS(n integer,t text); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope.text AS pg_catalog.text CHECK(length(VALUE)>1); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope.int4 AS pg_catalog.int4 CHECK(VALUE>10); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope."integer" AS pg_catalog.int4 CHECK(VALUE>20); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope.float8 AS pg_catalog.float8 CHECK(VALUE>0); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope.interval AS pg_catalog.interval CHECK(VALUE>INTERVAL '0 seconds'); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope.varchar AS pg_catalog.text CHECK(VALUE='ok'); CREATE DOMAIN cq_scope."TEXT" AS pg_catalog.text CHECK(length(VALUE)>1); CREATE TABLE public.cq_input(id integer PRIMARY KEY, v integer, s text); INSERT INTO public.cq_input VALUES(1,12,'x')
SELECT INTERVAL '-1 day'::interval day to second(3)::pg_catalog.text AS v

CREATE TYPE cq_scope.byte_holder AS(c pg_catalog."char"); CREATE TABLE public.cq_bytes(id integer PRIMARY KEY,c pg_catalog."char",a pg_catalog."char"[],r cq_scope.byte_holder); INSERT INTO public.cq_bytes VALUES(1,'\377',ARRAY['\377'::pg_catalog."char",'é'::pg_catalog."char"],ROW('é'::pg_catalog."char")::cq_scope.byte_holder); CREATE VIEW public.cq_byte_view AS SELECT id,c,c::pg_catalog."char" AS same,c::pg_catalog.text AS rendered,a,r FROM public.cq_bytes
SELECT c,c::pg_catalog.int4 AS i,a,r,(r).c::pg_catalog.text AS field FROM public.cq_byte_view

CREATE TABLE public.cq_narrow(id smallint PRIMARY KEY,t pg_catalog.varchar(4)); INSERT INTO public.cq_narrow VALUES(1,'abcd'); CREATE VIEW public.cq_narrow_view AS SELECT id::pg_catalog.int2 AS id,t::pg_catalog.varchar(4) AS same,t::pg_catalog.varchar(2) AS limited FROM public.cq_narrow
CREATE VIEW public.cq_cte AS WITH q AS (SELECT v,s FROM public.cq_input) SELECT v::pg_catalog.int4 AS v,s::pg_catalog.text AS s FROM q

SELECT 'pg_catalog.text'::regtype::pg_catalog.text AS text, 'pg_catalog.int4'::regtype::pg_catalog.text AS integer, 'pg_catalog.record'::regtype::pg_catalog.text AS record, 'pg_catalog.float8'::regtype::pg_catalog.text AS float
SELECT COALESCE(s,'x') AS v, GREATEST(s,'x') AS g FROM public.cq_input
CREATE VIEW public.cq_bound AS SELECT id,(v)::integer AS i,(s)::pg_catalog.text AS t,(v)::pg_catalog.float8 AS f FROM public.cq_input
SELECT id,i,t,f::pg_catalog.text AS f FROM public.cq_bound
PREPARE cq_bound_parameter AS SELECT pg_typeof($1::pg_catalog.text)='pg_catalog.text'::regtype AS v
SELECT parameter_types::pg_catalog.text AS v FROM pg_prepared_statements WHERE name='cq_bound_parameter'
CREATE FUNCTION public.cq_cast(i integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE SQL RETURN i::pg_catalog.int4
CREATE VIEW public.cq_byte_literal AS SELECT 'é'::pg_catalog."char" AS c
SELECT format_type(1042,-1) AS explicit,format_type(1042,NULL) AS implicit
SELECT id,i,t,f::text AS f FROM public.cq_bound
CREATE FUNCTION public.cq_text() RETURNS text LANGUAGE SQL RETURN 'x'::text
SET search_path=cq_scope,pg_catalog,public; SELECT public.cq_text() AS v

CREATE TABLE public.cq_char_parent(id pg_catalog."char" PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE public.cq_char_child(id pg_catalog.int4 PRIMARY KEY, p pg_catalog."char" REFERENCES public.cq_char_parent(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE); INSERT INTO public.cq_char_parent VALUES('a'); INSERT INTO public.cq_char_child VALUES(1,'a')
UPDATE public.cq_char_parent SET id='\377'::pg_catalog."char"; SELECT id::pg_catalog.int4 AS v FROM public.cq_char_parent; SELECT p::pg_catalog.int4 AS v FROM public.cq_char_child
CREATE TABLE public.cq_char_point(id pg_catalog.int4 PRIMARY KEY, c pg_catalog."char"); INSERT INTO public.cq_char_point VALUES(1,'a')
UPDATE public.cq_char_point SET c='\377'::pg_catalog."char" WHERE id=1; SELECT c::pg_catalog.int4 AS v FROM public.cq_char_point

CREATE TABLE public.cq_char_generated(c pg_catalog."char", g pg_catalog."char" GENERATED ALWAYS AS (c) STORED, v pg_catalog."char" GENERATED ALWAYS AS (c) VIRTUAL); INSERT INTO public.cq_char_generated(c) VALUES ('\377'::pg_catalog."char"); SELECT c::pg_catalog.int4 AS c,g::pg_catalog.int4 AS g,v::pg_catalog.int4 AS v FROM public.cq_char_generated

CREATE TABLE public.cq_char_default(id pg_catalog.int4 PRIMARY KEY, p pg_catalog."char" DEFAULT '\377'::pg_catalog."char" REFERENCES public.cq_char_parent(id) ON UPDATE SET DEFAULT); INSERT INTO public.cq_char_parent VALUES('b'); INSERT INTO public.cq_char_default VALUES(1,'b'); UPDATE public.cq_char_parent SET id='c' WHERE id='b'; SELECT p::pg_catalog.int4 AS v FROM public.cq_char_default
